item.title: Celebrating Victory Day of Bangladesh: The Day of Freedom and Unity!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
The journey of liberation is filled with struggles, obstacles and group efforts. The path to liberation in Bangladesh was marked by persistent suffering - nearly two centuries under British colonial control and another two and a half decades under Pakistani authorities' harsh dictatorship. Untold sorrows, life bonds and terrible atrocities became bitter chapters in our history.

Still, on 16th December 1971, Bangladesh emerged victorious after a nine-month-long difficult war and the supreme sacrifice of innumerable patriots. This pivotal moment in our history, a hard-fought victory, granted us the most precious gift of freedom upon us. Since then, 16th of December has served as our national holiday, a tribute to our perseverance and the communal spirit that triumphed over persecution.

Celebrating the Victory Day of Bangladesh is more than just acknowledging a historic event. It's about remembering the courage, unity and relentless spirit that liberated a nation. Just as the spirit of freedom resonated on this day, the same feeling transpires when we engage in thrilling activities that captivate us and promote unity. Such is the case with plinko gambling, an exciting online activity that's gained traction lately. Plinko is a captivating game of chance that originated from a popular television game show. Revel in the unpredictability and thrill that is alike to the exhilaration Bangladesh faced when striving for independence. This game serves as an entertaining and engaging pastime, quite fitting for the dynamic and adventurous spirit of Bangladesh's Victory Day. Playing Plinko is similar to celebrating the ups and downs, trials and triumphs, and unity that defined Bangladesh's journey towards independence. Be it Victory Day or an ordinary day, indulging in casino can add a bit of thrill and excitement to the celebration. It encourages bonding and unity as friends, families, or even strangers come together for a friendly competition, fostering a spirit of camaraderie. In conclusion, Bangladesh's Victory Day is about more than freedom; it's about unity, courage, and human spirit. And that's something we can all celebrate, whether through commemorating significant events, or engaging in activities like plinko that brings us closer together. Experience the thrill of the unknown, enjoy the ride, and most importantly, never forget the spirit of unity.

Victory Day stands as a symbol of unity, as people from all walks of life join together to commemorate the sacrifices made for the country's independence. The day is marked by ceremonies, parades and various cultural events that pay homage to the heroes of the Liberation War. It serves as a reminder of the strength that lies in unity and the ability of a nation to overcome adversity when united in a common cause.

As we celebrate Victory Day, it is essential to honor the martyrs who secrifitheir lives for the freedom we enjoy today. Their sacrifices serve as a guiding light, inspiring future generations to cherish and protect the hard-fought liberties that define our national identity.

Beyond the historical significance, Victory Day is also a time to reflect on the progress and achievements that Bangladesh has made since gaining independence. It is an opportunity to celebrate the resilience of the nation and the strides taken in various fields, including education, economy and social development.

As we commemorate Victory Day, let us not only look back but also look forward. The spirit of independence instills in us the responsibility to contribute to the continued growth and prosperity of Bangladesh. It serves as a reminder that the freedom we celebrate today comes with a duty to build a better tomorrow for generations to come.

On this glorious day of December 16th, let us come together to celebrate the spirit of freedom and pay respect to the heroes who made it possible. Victory Day is not just a historical event; it is a living testament to the resilience, courage and unity of the Bangladeshi people. As we raise our flags and hearts in celebration, may the principles of liberty continue to guide our nation toward a brighter and more prosperous future.

Happy Victory Day, Bangladesh!

item.title: Let's Rewind 2023: A Golden Year at PriyoShop!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
As 2023 ends, PriyoShop, a leading B2B marketplace, is excited to share our achievements! This year was no ordinary ride; it was a superhero movie for Bangladeshi entrepreneurs! And PriyoShop had an excellent journey this year.

Growth Squad Assemble: We onboarded over 50,000 amazing MSMEs, each with a dream bigger than anything! We welcomed them into our marketplace, giving them access to 200+ famous brands – talk about a power-up!

Expanding Our Kingdom: We didn't just stay online; we built four new strongholds and expanded our territory in 63 Areas (Uttara, Feni, Chandpur, DakhsinKhan) so that even the most remote entrepreneur could join the fight for success!

WhatsApp to the Rescue: We make easy access for our MSMEs! This year, we launched the super-speedy WhatsApp Marketplace. Just say ‘Hi’ and boom! Over 5,000 products at your fingertips!

Tech Wizardry: Our tech wizards upgraded PriyoShop with lightning-fast searches, smart recommendations and features so easy.

Teamwork Makes the Dream Work: We built a community filled with workshops, events and online forums – because fighting for success is better with friends!

The Awards Came Rolling: The world noticed our superpowers! We won Sankalp Runner Up, X-pitch Top 100, Top 50 Startup Wheel, and Echelon Top 100 and many more! It's like winning all the Oscars for business!

As we close this chapter, we are grateful for your trust. We have seen dreams become empires, whispers of ambition become success stories, and the entrepreneurial spirit sings louder than ever!

But this is just the beginning! In 2024, we will keep building bridges, expanding horizons, and amplifying the power of community. Let's write the next chapter in Bangladesh's business success story, brighter and bolder than ever!

item.title: Empowering Bangladesh's MSMEs: PriyoShop and LankaBangla PLC Join Hands Together!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
In the vibrant landscape of Bangladesh's economy, where more than 5 million retailers play a crucial role, contributing over 30% to the country's GDP, empowering MSMEs becomes paramount. Recognizing the potential of these businesses, PriyoShop, the leading B2B marketplace, has taken a significant step towards fostering growth and digitalization by addressing a key challenge faced by MSMEs – the finance problem.

The MSMEs’ Finance Challenge:

Despite the number of opportunities available to MSMEs, financial restrictions sometimes hamper their growth. A lot of small businesses need more funds to buy items, making it difficult for them to satisfy market needs and efficiently service their clients. This financial barrier restricts company growth and results in missed opportunities and client unhappiness.

PriyoShop's Initiative:

Understanding the pivotal role of MSMEs in the economic landscape and their struggle with financial limitations, PriyoShop has embarked on a mission to empower these businesses. Recognizing that the ability to procure goods is a fundamental aspect of their operations, PriyoShop has strategically addressed the finance problem to unleash the full potential of MSMEs.

Strategic Partnership with LankaBangla Finance PLC:

In a ground-breaking move, PriyoShop has formed a strategic alliance with LankaBangla Finance PLC, a renowned financial institution in Bangladesh. The partnership seeks to improve MSMEs' purchasing power by providing them with financial assistance by providing them credit cards, they need to overcome capital constraints.

The Agreement's Key Objectives:

The agreement between PriyoShop and LankaBangla Finance PLC is geared towards addressing the pressing financial challenges faced by MSMEs. The key objectives of this partnership include:

1. Financial Support: MSMEs partnering with PriyoShop will have access to financial support from LankaBangla, enabling them to purchase goods and replenish their inventory without facing capital constraints.

2. Tailored Financial Solutions: LankaBangla Finance PLC will work closely with PriyoShop to develop customized financial solutions that cater to the unique needs of MSMEs, ensuring flexibility and affordability.

3. Capacity Building: Beyond financial assistance, the partnership aims to empower MSMEs through capacity-building initiatives, providing them with the knowledge and skills needed to navigate the evolving business landscape.

4. Digital Transformation: As part of the collaboration, PriyoShop and LankaBangla will jointly work towards digitalizing MSMEs, enabling them to harness the benefits of technology for streamlined operations and enhanced market reach.

Impact on MSMEs and the Economy:

This strategic partnership holds the potential to revolutionize the MSME sector in Bangladesh. By addressing the finance problem, PriyoShop and LankaBangla aim to unlock the buying capability of MSMEs, fostering their growth and contributing to the overall economic development of the country. The impact is expected to ripple across various sectors, leading to job creation, increased productivity, and a more resilient and dynamic business environment.

In a concerted effort to empower Bangladesh's MSMEs, PriyoShop's collaboration with LankaBangla Finance PLC marks a significant milestone. By tackling the finance problem head-on, this partnership is poised to breathe new life into the MSME sector, opening up avenues for growth and digital transformation. As these businesses gain access to the necessary financial support, the entire economy stands to benefit from their enhanced buying capability, ultimately propelling Bangladesh towards a more prosperous future.

item.title: PriyoShop Raised $5 Million in Pre-Series Funding to Empower MSMEs in Bangladesh!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
PriyoShop, Bangladesh's leading B2B marketplace, has successfully raised $5 million in Pre-series A funding to impact more customers with embedded finance and expand the territory across Bangladesh. PriyoShop's recent investment round, led by Century Oak Ventures, with participation from Evolution Ventures, Iterative, SOSV (Orbit Startups), GFR Fund, BonBillo, Accelerating Asia, South Asia Tech Partners, and Voltity. Participating investors came from San Francisco, Dubai, Indonesia, Thailand, Africa, and India—with many choosing to invest in Bangladesh for the first time, marking a significant milestone for the country’s startup ecosystem With this financial support, PriyoShop is positioned to introduce transformative solutions that will benefit businesses across various sectors. This diverse backing highlights confidence in PriyoShop's mission by fueling substantial expansion and innovation. 

PriyoShop plans to utilize the recently acquired funds to enhance its technological infrastructure, expanding its geographical reach while prioritizing the integration of innovative technologies. Focused on improving the shopping experience for small enterprises, PriyoShop aims to revolutionize the functioning of these businesses by seamlessly merging finance and technology. The objective is to facilitate easy procurement for small companies, ultimately ensuring their success in the market. With the allocated funds, PriyoShop is poised to equip small enterprises with the necessary tools, leveraging financial technology to reshape their operational landscape and foster growth. 

Bangladesh's market size is almost 200 billion USD and 97% of our country’s retail sales take place through informal retailers; e-commerce and modern retail play a smaller role. So, the majority of the retail transactions are actually taking place through neighbourhood shop retailers. But these shops are faced with a number of challenges like stockouts, earnings instability and lack of financing, factors that make it hard for their businesses to grow. PriyoShop has rapidly expanded, making a positive impact on its customers within a short period. Moving forward, PriyoShop will prioritize a growth strategy emphasizing cost efficiency, leveraging advanced technology, streamlined teams, and high-margin revenue streams. PriyoShop's commitment to revolutionizing the B2B sector extends beyond just technology; it fosters collaboration and connectivity among businesses, fostering a more integrated and responsive marketplace. Through these initiatives, PriyoShop is ready to redefine the traditional B2B landscape, creating a dynamic ecosystem that benefits all stakeholders. PriyoShop aims to bring about even more positive transformations in Bangladesh's supply chains. 

PriyoShop B2B marketplace was started in July 2021 by Asikul Alam Khan and Dipty Mandal after the pandemic hit. PriyoShop bridges the gap between mom-and-pop shop owners, manufacturers, wholesalers and distributors. Operating on a robust assets-light marketplace model, PriyoShop also manages its own hubs to efficiently serve retailers. After the foundation, PriyoShop has experienced growth, demonstrating an impressive monthly revenue growth rate exceeding 14 times and a Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) growth of 36 times. PriyoShop is committed to addressing the widening gap between technology awareness and accessibility, a crucial challenge for the distribution business amidst challenges such as shrinking profit margins, complexities induced by inflation, and declining sales in various sectors. The company has diversified into new sectors, including HoReCa and Exclusive Partnerships, with plans to introduce a fintech ecosystem shortly. This ecosystem revolutionizes MSMEs' financial landscape by providing streamlined access to institutions, personalized credit assessments, and efficient supply chain financing. With simplified, paperless processes and flexible credit options, it fosters revenue growth through optimized operations and enhanced customer loyalty, marking a significant leap forward for businesses seeking financial empowerment.

Asikul Alam Khan, Founder & CEO of PriyoShop, expressed his enthusiasm about the investment, stating, "We want to thank all the backers, team players, industry mates and all the well-wishers in this journey. This funding marks a central moment for PriyoShop and validates our commitment to empowering Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in Bangladesh. The capital will be strategically deployed to enhance our technology infrastructure, expand our reach, and introduce innovative solutions, including the upcoming fintech service. “ Asikul added about PriyoShop's vision “We have made a great difference to the lives of small-business owners over the last two years. At present, we have roughly 50,000 merchants on our platform, and we expect to positively impact over 1 million merchants in the coming year."

Quoc Phong Dang, CEO, Century Oak Ventures, states, “We are thrilled to support PriyoShop in their current funding round, as we are impressed by their robust business model and strong execution.”

Oscar Ramos, Managing Director, Orbit Startups, states, "PriyoShop's customer-centric approach and relentless execution have enabled the company to emerge as a leading player in a competitive space. Team SOSV is proud and happy to be with PriyoShop."

Brian Ma, General Partner from Iterative, said, "We are excited to continue investing in PriyoShop. Its asset-light model is uniquely positioned to transform the informal retail sector in Bangladesh."

Founder Asikul Alam Khan emphasizes the critical role of supply chains in the economies of major South Asian and Southeast Asian countries, attributing around 60% of their GDP to these networks. He underscores the inevitability of modernization and digitalization for these supply chains to adapt and thrive in the evolving economic landscape.

PriyoShop through their PriyoShop Retail App and WhatsApp Marketplace solves this by providing a marketplace where MSMEs can source goods directly, which also keeps the prices of products competitive by removing the need for agents, and ensures the next-day delivery of goods. With all these facilities, PriyoShop helps MSMEs generate double-digit revenue. The startup has a partnership with LankaBangla Financing, a digital financial marketplace platform, to provide credit facilities to MSMEs.

Brian Ma, General Partner, and Hsu Ken Ooi, Co-Founder & Managing Partner of Iterative (Singapore-based venture capital firm) have recently visited Bangladesh's smart distribution platform (B2B marketplace) PriyoShop's office. Their close involvement with various teams shows a collaborative approach to optimising operations and overcoming problems. This hands-on participation demonstrated Iterative's dedication to promoting innovation and growth inside the PriyoShop ecosystem, eventually empowering MSMEs across Bangladesh.

About this visit of the founders of Iterative to Bangladesh, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of PriyoShop, Asikul Alam Khan, stated, "I have received many directions from them to facilitate the business process of the MSMEs in the country. item.title: How PriyoShop unlocked new windows for a local supplier!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
Imagine a local lentil supplier, with a strong desire to expand his territory but couldn't make it happen because of the limited manpower and a lack of proper guidance, holding his business to his known areas where he has served for the last decades.

But then, PriyoShop entered the scene and transformed his dream into reality. How? Let's explore!

PriyoShop is not just a usual marketplace. It is a revolutionary B2B marketplace, committed to enabling retailers such as our lentil supplier. What's the mission of PriyoShop? To bridge the gap between retailers (MSMEs), major brands and financial institutions. How does PriyoShop do this? Through a powerful and user-friendly application.

This app is the key to unlocking untapped opportunities for MSMEs. With PriyoShop, retailers have access to a huge inventory of over 4,500 SKUs from a network of more than 200 locally and internationally renowned brands, putting the global marketplace at their fingertips. Over are the days of limited options and regional limits.

But PriyoShop doesn't stop at empowering only the MSMEs. PriyoShop understands the importance of this ecosystem. Brands and suppliers, such as this lentil hero, are given a specialized platform to manage their operations successfully. Updating product information, pricing and tracking MSME orders are simple.

The influence is undeniable. Our lentil supplier, with some barriers and limits, is now reaching out to new consumers even if he doesn't need to do anything. Just receive the orders and deliver them to PriyoShop.  PriyoShop has become the missing link, the bridge that connects ambition and success.

This is just one story among thousands. PriyoShop is transforming the B2B landscape in Bangladesh by empowering retailers, suppliers and brands. item.title: Celebrating Mothers Day: A Legacy of Love and Empowerment at PriyoShop!
item.dc:creator: Tosar

Every year the second Sunday of May transforms into a global celebration for mothers. This year, on May 12th, we at PriyoShop join the chorus in expressing our deepest gratitude to the incredible women who nurture, inspire and empower us. But Mother's Day is more than just cards, flowers and brunch. Today, we delve into this tradition's history, explore women's evolving role in our society, and celebrate PriyoShop's commitment to creating a space where women can thrive.

The History of Mother's Day

The origins of Mother's Day can be traced back to ancient civilizations, where celebrations honouring mothers and motherhood existed. However, the modern iteration we recognise today has a more recent origin story. In early 20th century in America, Anna Jarvis, deeply affected by her mother's passing, campaigned for a dedicated day to honour mothers. Her efforts culminated in 1914 when President Woodrow Wilson declared the second Sunday of May as Mother's Day.

While the tradition of expressing love and appreciation to mothers remains constant, the societal landscape surrounding women has undergone a significant transformation. Today, women are shattering glass ceilings, excelling in diverse fields, and actively shaping the world around them. This shift extends to the world of retail as well.

We believe in treating everyone equally and making sure everyone has what they need to succeed. Our goal is to make PriyoShop a place where every woman feels respected and can thrive.

Celebrating Mothers Who Empower Others

This Mother's Day, we celebrate not just the nurturing mothers within our families, but also the mothers who inspire and empower others. item.title: Celebrating Father’s Day: Honoring the Unsung Heroes!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
Father’s Day - a day with love, emotions, respect and memories! This day is observed on the 3rd Sunday of June and has been traditionally dedicated to pay homage to the greatness of fathers and father-figures who raised us. It is a special day to celebrate their loyalty, affection and guidance which often comes with the wonderful experience of a life-time. Instead, there remains a silent understanding that fathers play the role of wise providers at home and are as crucial as mothers. It discusses the concept of honouring such icons and discovering purposeful means of commemorating Father’s Day.

The Origins of Father’s Day

The history of Father’s Day dates back to the early 20th century. The idea was first proposed by Sonora Smart Dodd in Spokane, Washington, in 1910. Inspired by the way Mother’s Day honored mothers, Dodd wanted a similar day to celebrate fathers, especially her own father, who single-handedly raised her and her siblings. Over the years, the concept gained popularity, and in 1972, President Richard Nixon signed a proclamation making Father’s Day a national holiday in the United States.

The Role of Fathers in Our Lives

Fathers play a multifaceted role in the family structure. They are providers, protectors, mentors and friends. Their influence extends beyond financial support; they shape our values, instill discipline, and offer guidance during life’s challenges. Fathers teach us the importance of hard work, integrity and resilience. They are often the ones who show us how to tackle problems head-on and face the world with confidence.

Acknowledging All Father-Figures

It’s important to remember that Father’s Day is not just for biological fathers. Many people have father figures who have made significant impacts on their lives. Grandfathers, stepfathers, uncles, mentors, and even older brothers can embody the spirit of fatherhood. Take this day to honor all the men who have provided guidance, support, and love.

Father’s Day is a beautiful reminder to appreciate the often-overlooked contributions of fathers. Their quiet strength and steadfast presence provide the foundation for families to thrive. As we celebrate this special day, let’s make an effort to show our fathers and father figures how much they mean to us. Whether through simple gestures or grand celebrations, what matters most is the recognition and appreciation of their invaluable role in our lives.

So, this Father’s Day, let’s give our dads the honor they deserve and create memories that will be cherished for years to come. After all, behind every great individual is a father who believed in them.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value: Father’s Day tribute - Honoring fathers - Unsung heroes of family - Role of fathers

item.title: Celebrating MSME Day: Honoring the Backbone of the Global Economy!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
Every June 27th the world comes together to celebrate Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) on MSME Day. These enterprises are the backbone of the global economy, driving innovation, creating jobs, and fostering vibrant communities.

Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2017, MSME Day aims to raise awareness about the important role of micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises in our societies. It provides a platform to recognize and celebrate their remarkable impact on economies worldwide.

The Importance of MSMEs Globally

MSMEs constitute a staggering 90% of all businesses worldwide, creating over 70% of jobs and contributing to half of the world’s GDP. These enterprises are vital for economic growth and development, particularly in developing countries where they often represent the majority of businesses. MSMEs drive innovation by introducing new products and services, fostering competition, and promoting diverse economic activities. They also play a crucial role in achieving sustainable development by providing opportunities for social inclusion, reducing poverty, and promoting equitable growth.

MSMEs in Bangladesh: A Growing Sector

In Bangladesh, the MSME sector is thriving. With over 5 million retailers, the sector sees more than 70,000 new MSMEs joining every year. These businesses are integral to the country's economy, providing livelihoods for millions of people and contributing significantly to national GDP up to 34%. The dynamic and entrepreneurial spirit of Bangladeshi MSMEs has led to substantial economic development and progress, making them a cornerstone of the nation’s economic landscape and generating more profit by up to 25%. 

The Impact of MSMEs on Job Creation and Innovation

One of the most significant contributions of MSMEs is their role in job creation. By employing a large portion of the workforce, MSMEs help reduce unemployment and improve living standards. These enterprises often provide jobs in local communities, promoting regional development and reducing urban migration pressures. Furthermore, MSMEs are hotbeds of innovation, continuously adapting to changing market demands and leveraging new technologies to stay competitive. Their ability to innovate not only drives their success but also contributes to the overall dynamism and resilience of the economy.

Supporting and Empowering MSMEs

Supporting and empowering MSMEs is essential for harnessing their full potential. This can be achieved through various means, such as providing access to finance, improving infrastructure, offering training and development programs, and fostering a conducive regulatory environment. Governments, financial institutions, and international organizations play a critical role in creating an enabling environment for MSMEs to thrive. By addressing the challenges these enterprises face, PriyoShop is providing them with a smart solution PriyoShop App with embedded finance, which will help them unlock their potential to drive inclusive, resilient, and sustainable economic growth.

PriyoShop: Revolutionizing the MSME Sector in Bangladesh

In the heart of Bangladesh's thriving MSME sector stands PriyoShop, an eB2B marketplace revolutionizing the way micro, small, and medium enterprises operate. PriyoShop provides a digital platform that connects retailers with suppliers, streamlining the supply chain and enhancing business efficiency. By leveraging technology, PriyoShop offers MSMEs access to a wide range of products at competitive prices, reliable delivery services, and transparent transactions. This not only helps MSMEs save time and reduce costs but also empowers them to compete effectively in the market. On MSME Day, PriyoShop celebrates the resilience and ingenuity of these enterprises, reaffirming its commitment to supporting their growth and success. Through initiatives like training programs, financial support, and digital solutions, PriyoShop continues to play a pivotal role in strengthening the MSME sector in Bangladesh.

As we celebrate MSME Day, it is essential to recognize and appreciate the vital contributions of MSMEs to the global economy. These businesses drive innovation, create jobs, and foster sustainable development, making them indispensable to our economic and social well-being. By supporting and empowering MSMEs, we can build a more inclusive, resilient, and prosperous global economy. Let us honor the remarkable impact of MSMEs and continue to champion their growth and success for a brighter future.

On this MSME Day, let us acknowledge the hard work and dedication of MSMEs around the world. Their contributions are a testament to the power of entrepreneurship and the potential of small businesses to drive significant change. As we move forward, it is crucial to continue providing the support and resources necessary for MSMEs to thrive, ensuring a more vibrant and sustainable economic landscape for all.

item.title: Our Heroes Serving MSMEs During Challenging Times: PriyoShop's Commitment to Retailers!
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
In recent weeks Bangladeshi micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), which form the backbone of the country’s retail sector, have faced extraordinary challenges. These small retailers (particularly mom-and-pop shops) often operating with limited resources, faced the daunting task of sustaining their businesses amidst unprecedented difficulties. As the movement progressed in the country, many shop owners found themselves out of stock, unable to replenish their shelves due to the widespread disruptions. It was during this critical time that PriyoShop stepped up to play a pivotal role in supporting these retailers, reaffirming its commitment to empowering MSMEs even in the most challenging of circumstances.

While the country grappled with the implications of the movement, PriyoShop remained steadfast in its mission to serve MSMEs. Our dedicated front-line team, who we fondly refer to as our heroes, went above and beyond to ensure that the needs of our retail partners were met. Despite the challenges, including internet downtimes and logistical obstacles, PriyoShop continued to operate, providing essential support to mom-and-pop shops across Bangladesh.

Retailers who had previously placed their trust in PriyoShop found that this trust was well-founded. Even as others struggled to maintain operations, PriyoShop ensured that orders were taken and processed efficiently. This unwavering dedication not only helped keep businesses running but also reinforced the confidence that retailers have in PriyoShop as a reliable partner during times of crisis.

The movement brought about significant challenges, including disruptions to communication and supply chains. However, PriyoShop's team was quick to adapt, implementing innovative solutions to bridge the gap between retailers and the essential goods they needed. Our front-line heroes worked tirelessly to ensure that orders were processed and delivered with minimal delay, even in areas where internet connectivity was compromised.

This commitment to service was not limited to the operational team. PriyoShop’s management also took an active role in addressing the challenges faced by our retail partners. Senior management members visited the field, meeting with mom-and-pop shop owners to assess the situation firsthand. These visits were crucial in understanding the unique challenges faced by each retailer and provided an opportunity to gather valuable feedback that could inform future strategies.

The field visits conducted by PriyoShop's management were more than just a means of assessing the situation; they were a testament to the company’s dedication to building strong, lasting relationships with its retail partners. By engaging directly with shop owners, PriyoShop was able to offer personalized support tailored to the specific needs of each business. This hands-on approach not only ensured that retailers could continue operating during the movement but also strengthened the bond between PriyoShop and the MSMEs it serves.

These interactions provided a platform for open dialogue, where shop owners could share their concerns, challenges and ideas for improvement. PriyoShop took this feedback to heart, using it to drive innovation and develop new solutions aimed at enhancing the retail experience. Whether it was identifying more efficient ways to manage inventory, improving delivery logistics, or offering better pricing strategies, PriyoShop demonstrated its commitment to being a true partner in the growth and success of MSMEs.

At the core of PriyoShop’s efforts during this challenging time was a commitment to empowering local businesses with the best products, prices and services. The company understands that the success of MSMEs is integral to the overall economic health of Bangladesh, and as such, it is dedicated to providing the tools and support necessary for these businesses to thrive.

PriyoShop's response to the recent movement is a clear reflection of its values and mission. By remaining operational and responsive, even in the face of adversity, PriyoShop has solidified its reputation as a reliable partner for MSMEs. The company’s ability to adapt to challenging circumstances, combined with its proactive approach to problem-solving, ensures that retailers can continue to rely on PriyoShop for their business needs.

As Bangladesh begins to recover from the challenges of the past weeks, PriyoShop remains committed to the success and growth of MSMEs across the country. The recent movement has highlighted the importance of resilience, adaptability and strong partnerships. PriyoShop is proud to stand alongside its retail partners, helping them navigate these difficult times and emerge stronger on the other side.

item.title: Driving Sustainable Growth, PriyoShop’s Commitment to Eco-Friendly Practices in Bangladesh’s MSME Sector
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
PriyoShop is a buzzing brand in the MSME sector of Bangladesh. We are stepping ahead with hopes for everlasting progress and development by introducing environmental sustainability in Bangladesh along with a persistent economic upswing.  As the world has increased its focus on ecological resilience, PriyoShop has made a bold commitment to eco-friendly practices, opting for a greener, better and more sustainable future for Bangladesh. 

ESG - An Opportunity to Differentiate

In today’s world sustainability isn’t just a buzzword - it’s a business necessity. Traditional ways of gaining a competitive edge are no longer enough. With global trade and more aware, eco-conscious consumers, international brands are now pushing for stronger Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) practices from their suppliers. And this economic awareness is compulsory for Bangladesh as well. This is why PriyoShop is not falling behind regarding its environmental responsibilities. 

But how is PriyoShop integrating Sustainability? PriyoShop is stepping up to reduce carbon footprints. We are doing our part by installing solar panels, switching to electric vehicles (EV), paddle vans, and using smart ventilation to maximize natural light. PriyoShop ensures that the products reaching our targeted customers are not only of high quality but also produced with minimal environmental impact. With all these efforts we are trying to be carbon neutral by 2026. It is a clarion call from our heart that we must aspire to build a better Bangladesh by putting the environment and sustainable growth first. 

Aggregating and Empowering MSMEs with Sustainable Solutions

PriyoShop commits beyond the business growth and its operation. We have successfully created a reliable platform that connects small businesses to a wider market. But our mission goes beyond just reducing our carbon footprint. We are committed to leading the way toward a greener future. By aligning with the Zero Carbon Mission, PriyoShop is actively reducing emissions and promoting sustainability throughout our entire value chain. We are not just minimizing our impact; we are driving meaningful change towards a sustainable Bangladesh.

PriyoShop is providing MSMEs with the necessary tools and resources they need to reduce their carbon footprint. With resource management, access to eco-friendly packaging options, workforce development,  or guidance on energy efficiency, carbon reduction methods, material management, and sustainable production methods PriyoShop is making sustainability accessible and achievable for businesses of all sizes. It is our achievement that we are delivering world-class sustainability solutions to our MSMEs of Bangladesh. 

Our Specific, Measurable Green Goals

Actions speak louder than words regarding the climate crisis. We feel the urgency to resolve the sustainability problem because it requires immediate actions for not only our future generation but also for our very own survival. Although we have taken major steps to avert natural catastrophes. In 2024 we are setting achievable goals to focus more on our environmental initiatives and make a real difference. By having specific, measurable goals, we believe we can track our progress and ensure that our efforts have a positive impact. 

Our long-term goals are-

- Introducing Green Technology 

- Holistic Sustainability Approaches 

- Offsetting Carbon Emission 

- Reducing Energy Consumption 

- Expansion of our Green Hubs 

- Initiating Sustainability Efforts throughout the Supply Chain

We believe that aligning our goals with our core business model helps us to maintain integrity, as it is our connective tissue between what we do and who we are.

A Collaborative Approach to Sustainability

Every cause has its challenges and entrepreneurship support is no different. Thus real, measurable and sustainable impact will only be achieved by adopting an inclusive approach that is entrepreneur-centered. In our pursuit of sustainability measurements, we are collaborating and creating a comprehensive support ecosystem among MSMEs in Bangladesh. By pooling our expertise, infrastructure and funding, we can maximize our collective environmental and eco-friendly impact while minimizing redundancies which allows us to hope for a greener tomorrow. By participating in and organizing workshops, webinars and community events, PriyoShop fosters a culture of sustainability that resonates across the entire business ecosystem in Bangladesh.

The Green Road Ahead 

In a country where the MSME sector plays a crucial role in economic development, PriyoShop is proving that it’s possible to drive growth while protecting the environment. By leading the way in sustainable business practices, PriyoShop is not only securing a brighter future for Bangladesh’s businesses but also contributing to the global effort to combat climate change.

The company envisions a future where every business, regardless of size, can operate sustainably without compromising on growth or profitability. To achieve this, PriyoShop is exploring innovative solutions such as renewable energy sources for its operations, expanding its range of eco-friendly products, and continuing to support MSMEs in their journey towards sustainability.

Conclusion:

In Bangladesh’s fast-growing MSME sector, PriyoShop is leading the charge in sustainable growth. By embracing eco-friendly practices, PriyoShop is setting a new standard for businesses, showing that profitability and environmental responsibility can coexist. As PriyoShop continues to prioritize sustainability, it’s not only boosting economic growth but also shaping a greener, more sustainable future for Bangladesh. Let's go greener together!

item.title: Empowering MSMEs with Embedded Finance: A Successful Collaboration With Mastercard & LankaBangla
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
MSMEs need easy access to the finance and technology landscape because the overall business, finance and technology in this modern era are constantly evolving.

MSMEs require smooth access to credit and financing solutions because they have to survive and thrive at the same time. PriyoShop has addressed this financial gap while assessing the other hurdles like supply chain mismanagement, lack of brand connectivity and so on.

Recently, with LankaBangla Finance PLC and Mastercard, PriyoShop launched a pioneering credit card, the first ever CMSME card in Bangladesh, that aims to empower MSMEs. This major leap is going to make a more holistic financial offering for the MSMEs through embedded finance.

Understanding the Partnership:

The joint effort between PriyoShop, LankaBangla Finance, and Mastercard brings together three industry leaders with one particular vision: to empower MSMEs with the financial tools they need to grow and succeed. And each of these organizations brings unique strengths to the partnership:

  • PriyoShop, a trendsetter B2B e-commerce space in Bangladesh, has been simplifying the supply chains for MSMEs. PriyoShop offers an online platform where retailers can purchase goods from leading brands. PriyoShop has made business operations more efficient for its 78,000+ MSMEs. 
  • LankaBangla Finance, a prominent financial institution, has a long history of providing innovative financial solutions in Bangladesh. Their experience in lending, credit products and financial inclusion initiatives makes them an ideal partner in this endeavor.
  • Mastercard, a global leader in payment technology, is known for its innovative solutions that make payments faster, safer and more convenient. Their role in providing the infrastructure for this credit card ensures that the financial services offered are reliable, secure and user-friendly.

What is Embedded Finance?

Embedded finance is the next big thing in FinTech. Embedded finance is the integration of financial services into non-financial offerings.

Instead of having to go to a bank or a financial institution, businesses or individuals can access financial services directly through the platforms they already use—whether it's an e-commerce marketplace, a digital wallet, or a mobile app.

In the case of PriyoShop's relationship with LankaBangla and Mastercard, the embedded finance solution is a specific credit card for MSMEs.

Retailers who use PriyoShop’s platform for their business operations can now also access credit control with a simple process. This will help the MSMEs not to run to the local loan sharks or go through the long and traditional process of seeking credit through the banking channels.

What are the benefits of this CSMSME credit card? Surely it reduces friction, saves time, and enhances the overall business experience for retailers.


Why Financial Inclusion Matters for MSMEs

MSMEs are the backbone of Bangladesh's economy. There are around 10 million MSMEs in Bangladesh, employing roughly 80 percent of the population and responsible for half of the country’s industrial output. Despite their significant contributions, many MSMEs face challenges in accessing the capital they need to run their operations efficiently. Traditional lending institutions often require extensive documentation, collateral, and credit history, which many small businesses simply do not have. This results in many MSMEs turning to informal or expensive lending options, such as local loan sharks, which come with high interest rates and unfavorable terms.

The launch of the CMSME LankaBangla Mastercard Credit Card is a game-changer in this context. For the first time, MSMEs will have access to a formal line of credit that is specifically customized only for specific needs. 

Features and Benefits of the CMSME LankaBangla Mastercard Credit Card

The CMSME LankaBangla Mastercard Credit Card offers a variety of benefits designed to meet the specific needs of MSMEs in Bangladesh. Some of the key features include:

  1. Easy Access to Credit: MSMEs can now access credit directly through PriyoShop’s platform without having to go through the lengthy process of applying for a loan at a traditional bank.
  2. Hassle-Free Transactions: The card allows for seamless transactions both online and offline, enabling retailers to manage their finances with ease.
  3. Cash Flow Management: With the ability to make purchases on credit, MSMEs can better manage their cash flow, ensuring they have the resources they need to keep their businesses running smoothly.
  4. Increased Financial Security: The card also brings an added layer of financial security, as MSMEs are no longer dependent on high-risk, informal lending options.
  5. Build Credit History: For MSMEs that have never had formal credit before, this card offers the opportunity to build a positive credit history, which can open doors to future financing opportunities.

Impact on MSMEs and B2B Sector

The introduction of this credit card has the potential to change MSMEs and the broader B2B industry in Bangladesh.

Here’s how:

1. Improved Access to Working Capital

For MSMEs, working capital is essential to maintaining operations, purchasing inventory, and meeting day-to-day expenses. Unfortunately, there has always been a problem with the limited availability of official funding choices.

This credit card addresses that gap by providing an easy, accessible line of credit, enabling businesses to purchase goods and services on time, ensuring they can meet customer demand and avoid stock shortages.

2. Reduction in Dependence on Traditional Lending

Many MSMEs, especially those in rural or underserved areas, have historically relied on local loan sharks who charge high interest rates and operate without transparency. With the launch of the CMSME LankaBangla Mastercard Credit Card, PriyoShop is offering an authentic alternative to these loans, allowing MSMEs to break free from the cycle of debt and predatory lending practices.

3. Digital Transformation and Financial Inclusion

The larger digital transformation of Bangladesh's economy is going to happen through this collaboration. Introducing embedded finance solutions PriyoShop partnered with Lanaka Bangla and Mastercard, trying its best to move the MSMEs to less cash-based transactions and embrace digital payments. The MSMEs will feel more inclusive in the financial ecosystem.

4. Empowering Entrepreneurs and Small Business Owners

At its core, this partnership is about more empowerment. By providing MSMEs with the financial tools they need to grow and thrive, LankaBangla, Mastercard and PriyoShop are helping to create more sustainable growth in the business environment.

Future of Embedded Finance in B2B Sector

The CMSME card is just the beginning of the new era of MSMEs in Bangladesh because they will be more financially stronger.

By offering embedded finance solutions, companies like PriyoShop are not only one step closer to making it easier for MSMEs to access the capital they need but also creating more simple, easy and efficient business ecosystems.

We surely believe that as more businesses embrace these solutions, the barriers to growth for MSMEs will continue to diminish, paving the way for greater economic prosperity in Bangladesh.


Conclusion

Partnership with LankaBangla and Mastercard represents a significant milestone in the journey. By offering a credit card through embedded finance, PriyoShop is empowering B2B retailers to access the financial resources they need to grow their businesses. This collaboration is not just about providing credit; it's about creating a more sustainable, equitable business environment where MSMEs can thrive.

Together, PriyoShop, LankaBangla and Mastercard are setting a new standard for what it means to support MSMEs, ensuring that the future of Bangladesh's economy is bright and inclusive.

item.title: The Aspiring Journey of Md. Rasel from an Accounting Teacher to an Account Executive
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
Every person carries at least one winning story, and this story keeps them going through the struggles, giving them motivation to survive while things get tough. At PriyoShop, we believe in celebrating these winning stories—stories of resilience and determination.

Today, we are happy to introduce Md. Rasel, our newest Accounts Executive, whose journey is quite inspiring.

Overcoming Physical Barriers with Strength

Being physically challenged due to a polio attack in his early childhood, many would find excuses to be a burden to their family, whereas Rasel started to turn himself into an asset. 

Growing up with physical conditions in Bangladesh is not easy. Because social perceptions and physical barriers both create constant hurdles for people like him. The societal perception and physical barriers created constant challenges for Rasel.

He was often left alone in school due to his circumstances. However, Rasel never allowed his physical limitations to hold him back. He made up his mind that whatever life throws at him, he will endure and never lose hope. Denying all odds, he focused on education, gaining a deep understanding of accounting, which later became his professional calling.

A Passionate Teacher Who Loved Teaching

Rasel spent his time before joining PriyoShop teaching students about financial numbers. His students liked his teaching ability and the way he dealt with life.

However, like many during the pandemic, Rasel faced unexpected challenges. Due to the lockdown, he lost his students. Then the second shock wave came, which was a shift in accounting syllabuses, and the loss of teaching opportunities hit him hard.

Despite his vast experience and love for teaching, Rasel had to make a tough decision to shift his career for the sake of financial stability and his family’s wellbeing.

item.title: Thriving Against All Odds: How PriyoShop Empowers Bangladesh's MSMEs
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
In Bangladesh MSMEs have been thriving, denying all the odds they face. As many as 24 million people are engaged in MSMEs. The number is pretty remarkable. Although they are emerging rapidly, they are underserved, facing several gridlocks. One of the major gridlocks is the complex supply chains.

Most of the MSMEs in Bangladesh struggle to have a smooth supply chain. Going to the local supply market, closing the shops for a day-long time, transportation hurdles, lack of credit facilities, price transparency issues, and many more issues they face every single day.

Assessing all these bottlenecks, PriyoShop has been working with MSMEs by providing them with a simple and effective supply-chain solution. And the solution is making a real difference in our retail customer's lives. Our retailers have been vocal about their satisfaction with our services!

Effortless Supply Chain, Every Time

Retailers have promptly praised PriyoShop for the simplified supply chain method. We have connected the retailers with premium brands, which eliminated the traditional supply chain complexities. This direct connection made sure that the MSMEs got price transparency, received the inventory promptly, and served their end-to-end customers more reliably. 

One retailer shared - "As a mom-and-pop shop, I used to struggle with stocking up on popular items. Now, with PriyoShop, I can restock effortlessly. The process is fast, and I always receive my deliveries on time."

Monthly Transactions Made Easy

We installed a platform that accommodates monthly transactions smoothly and hassle-free. We ensured that the retailers could always have a consistent flow of inventories in their shops without being stressed about cash flow. 

Another retailer, Mehedi Hasan from Vuter Goli, adds, "With PriyoShop, monthly transactions are easy and stress-free. I can pay on time and get my supplies without delay. It’s a reliable system that keeps my business running smoothly."

Connecting and Building Effective Business Relationships

With our retail customers, we create a professional building. Our management teams regularly visit the field. This helps us to accumulate valuable feedback and unique challenges faced by each one of the retailers This first-hand approach helps us to innovate more solutions to mitigate the challenges. MSMEs growth is our core mission, which is why we provide hands-on solutions. 

At PriyoShop, we try our best to empower the MSMEs with the gear and gadgets they need to ease their day-to-day business. The positive feedback makes us go the extra mile. We are proud of the relationships we have built with our retailers, and we will continue to push forward.

PriyoShop: Driving Supplier Growth through Innovation, Transparency and Trust

PriyoShop is one of the leading B2B companies in Bangladesh. Being one of pioneer B2B marketplaces, it enjoys an unparalleled reputation, which is created by them, taking months after months. PriyoShop is well-known for its seamless payment method towards its suppliers, innovating digital solutions for their MSMEs, creating fintech solutions and whatnot! PriyoShop is making life easier for both the suppliers and MSMEs at the same time. Let’s go further to learn how they are creating impact and differences.

An Efficient and Seamless Collaboration: 

Small suppliers who collaborated with PriyoShop are leveraging PriyoShop’s technology and innovative business approach, which is rocketing up their sales and generating a constant margin of revenue throughout the year. PriyoShop is not only targeting the underserved MSMEs but also the suppliers, expanding economic transparency. One of the standout points of them is the timely and prompt payment PriyoShop makes to the supplier. These local and small suppliers no longer worry about delayed payments, and a sense of trust and mutual respect has been fostered.

Transparency at its Best:

PriyoShop prides itself on maintaining a high level of transparency in all dealings. Suppliers have access to detailed information regarding their deliveries, payments and are updated on inventory levels so that they can supply whenever needed. This transparency minimizes confusion, reduces errors, and promotes a fair and straightforward business environment.

Voices from the Suppliers:

Countless suppliers have shared their experiences with PriyoShop:

Abu Zafor Ahmed: “Each month PriyoShop purchases supplies, and their payment punctuality is impeccable. They deal with me very politely and professionally, which makes the transactions hassle-free and smooth.”

Md. Sohel Rana: “PriyoShop conducts professionally, and they maintain efficiency in transactions. By partnering with them, our sales have increased, and we look forward to a continued partnership with Priyoshop as we both strive to provide exceptional value to our customers.”

Building an Ecosystem and Easing Life:

Many aged suppliers struggle to continue their day-to-day business due to their age, physical condition, and lack of digital knowledge. Or some young, dedicated small suppliers who are still learning the business and don’t know where to reach for better business exposure or manage capital on their own. This is where PriyoShop steps in. Empowering these small suppliers along with the MSMEs by reaching them and being a prompt purchaser reduces both the sufferings of these suppliers and MSMEs. It's building a stronger, more resilient retail ecosystem. Suppliers can focus on growing their businesses without the constant worry of payment delays or lack of clarity. This empowerment drives innovation and growth, benefiting the entire supply chain.

Looking Ahead:

As PriyoShop continues to expand its network and enhance its platform, the goal remains the same: to provide an unparalleled partnership experience for suppliers. By maintaining its dedication to transparency and efficiency, PriyoShop is setting a new standard in the industry, one that prioritizes trust, reliability, and mutual success. In conclusion, the partnership with PriyoShop is more than just a business transaction—it's a collaborative effort to build a better future for suppliers and the retail industry as a whole. Here's to many more success stories and a thriving partnership ecosystem!

item.title: How PriyoShop is Building a Sustainable Future with Renewable Energy and Low-Carbon Commutes
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
As the world grapples with the challenges posed by climate change and strives for a more sustainable future, corporations' roles become increasingly important. The urgency of addressing climate change and environmental degradation has led to a growing emphasis on making more sustainable business decisions.

PriyoShop, known as the leading B2B company, has developed a sustainable portfolio with an ambition to go as a carbon-free company within 2025. Moreover, taking initiatives to reduce dependence on electric consumption.

With a passion for the environmental mission, PriyoShop is initiating more strides to make the earth cooler. As a proven commitment, Priyoshop has launched several ‘Green Hubs’. These hubs are eco-friendly centers for storing branded supplies, which are designed to reduce environmental impact while ensuring smooth business operations.

ESG Integration in PriyoShop

PriyoShop has taken steps to establish sustainable hubs with renewable energy initiatives and clean transportation. These initiatives aim to attract both domestic and international investors interested in contributing to sustainable development while generating returns. With the sustainable distribution ecosystem, PriyoShop is operating more effectively without compromising the planet’s health.

By installing solar panels and a natural light induction system in these hubs, PriyoShop is utilizing renewable energy. This helps to reduce the company’s reliance on conventional electricity, cutting down carbon emissions significantly. These simple and effective measures clearly state that PriyoShop is determined to minimize its carbon footprint.

Introducing More Low-Carbon Commute

To restore the environment, the company has introduced paddle vans and electric vans (EV) to transport goods to MSMEs (Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises) across the country. This eco-friendly fleet offers a low-carbon alternative to traditional fuel-based vehicles. It is more helpful in densely populated areas. These vehicles particularly help to reduce air pollution while maintaining efficient delivery systems.

This shift to a greener and cleaner transportation system is benefitting the environment and strengthening the brand name and value as well.

A Sustainable Business Model

Combining sustainable technology with strategic business operations, PriyoShop fosters the green and sets a new standard for B2B companies in Bangladesh. They are installing green hubs in multiple locations, catering to the ever-growing MSMEs with smooth service with a positive environmental impact. 

With solar energy, natural lighting, and eco-friendly transport, PriyoShop’s Green Hubs are demonstrating that businesses practicing sustainability can drive both success and positive social change.

The Green Road Ahead

Looking forward to the future, the Green Hubs stand as a cornerstone of their long-term vision. Priyoshop is aiming to further expand its green network, which will promote carbon neutrality by embracing more sustainable solutions. This reflects their unflagging commitment to both their business and the environment.

We are also providing resources to the MSMEs and introducing more green hubs to create more green spaces for them to thrive more consciously. All the sustainable initiatives are increasing the sense of well-being and improving the quality of life of local MSMEs and the environment as well.

Final Thoughts

PriyoShop is acting now to restore the environment with a holistic approach against climate change – mitigating environmental impact and offering hope of a sustainable future for all of us. They are trying their best to build a collection of changes with their people and capabilities in this ever-changing climate. They are stating through their initiatives that all the businesses can grow without hurting plants.

At PriyoShop, we are not just about business; we are about building a sustainable future for all.

item.title: Embracing Digitalization: Bangladesh's Digital Rise and PriyoShop's Role in Empowering MSMEs
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
Bangladesh is a country with rich and versatile stories of history and culture. The country is fundamentally grown in the digital sector as well. With easy access to the internet, mobile connectivity, and using the latest technology in day-to-day life, the future of this nation looks more inclusive and powerful. Regarding the expanded digitization, numerous companies adopted the changes in the meantime. And as a tech-driven company, PriyoShop is playing an essential role in empowering micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) with digital solutions that foster growth, resilience and sustainability.

The Digital Transformation of Bangladesh

Bangladesh has undergone many catalysts since its sovereignty. Still, it has strikingly raised its standard of poverty and education. Step by step, it embraced technology for socioeconomic development. Although it was quite tough, they made it possible by creating tech awareness among the masses. Today, internet connectivity and mobile phone penetration have seen unprecedented growth, with millions of internet users and mobile subscriptions nearing the country’s total population. This shift has revolutionized various sectors, from education and healthcare to agriculture and finance, making digital access not just a privilege but an expectation. 

Digitalization has been impacted noticeably by intriguing mobile banking and e-commerce platforms that are making financial services accessible to a broader population. Fintech solutions are becoming integral to daily life. However, to unlock the full potential of this digital age, empowering MSMEs, the backbone of Bangladesh's economy, remains crucial.

Challenges of MSMEs Adapting Technology

While digitalization offers remarkable potential, MSMEs in Bangladesh face unique challenges in adopting these solutions. Many MSMEs lack the digital literacy and resources to navigate digital tools effectively, which leads them to transact in cash. These cash-based transactions limit their growth and access to formal financing. The banking sector’s limited reach into remote areas and complex credit policies make it challenging for MSMEs to secure funding for the expansion of their small businesses. 

Moreover, the competitive situation of the market requires MSMEs to adapt quickly, staying ahead through improved efficiency, real-time data insights, and better supply chain management. Addressing these challenges requires a dedicated approach to bringing technology to the grassroots level.


How PriyoShop is Empowering MSMEs with Digital Solutions

Addressing all these challenges, PriyoShop, the pioneering B2B marketplace platform, started with a mission in their mind to act as an equalizer in the lives of MSMEs by offering innovative digital solutions that simplify business operations, improve financial inclusion and foster growth.

Let’s have a look at how PriyoShop is bridging the gap for MSMEs:

  1. Simplifying the Supply Chain through Digital Access
    PriyoShop connects MSMEs with leading brands, allowing them to access essential products directly from suppliers. This simplified supply chain solution reduces unnecessary middlemen costs, ensuring fair prices and a reliable supply of goods like FMCG and hygiene products from brands like Reckitt, ACI and Square. PriyoShop’s digital platform enables entrepreneurs to place orders quickly and manage inventory in real-time, eliminating traditional paperwork and reducing manual errors.
  2. Financial Inclusion through Fintech Partnerships
    PriyoShop has partnered with fintech providers like LankaBangla Finance and Mastercard to offer credit cards specifically designed for MSMEs. This partnership enables MSMEs to access the formal financial system and enjoy flexible credit options, helping them secure working capital without needing high-interest loans. By digitizing payment processes and facilitating access to credit, PriyoShop empowers MSMEs to scale operations confidently and sustainably.
  3. Empowering MSMEs with Advanced Software Solutions
    With software solutions, MSMEs in the HoReCa (Hotel, Restaurant, Cafe) sector can leverage digital technology to enhance their operations. The POS systems improve customer service, track sales, manage inventory, and create data insights that guide business decisions. For small businesses, this is invaluable for staying competitive and responsive in an evolving market.
  4. Practicing Environmental Sustainability
    PriyoShop has been opting for sustainable practices in its business model by implementing eco-friendly energy solutions, such as natural lighting and solar power, in rural branches. Through these green initiatives, PriyoShop not only reduces operational costs but also contributes to environmental responsibility—a growing priority among today’s communities. 


The Future of Digital Transformation for MSMEs in Bangladesh

As Bangladesh’s digital economy continues to grow, the role of MSMEs is undeniably pivotal. By integrating digital tools and solutions, these enterprises can become more competitive, transparent, and resilient. PriyoShop’s vision to empower one million MSMEs by 2025 reflects the potential of technology to transform businesses, improve livelihoods, and drive economic growth.

The journey is not without challenges, but with continued collaboration among government bodies, fintech innovators and platforms like PriyoShop, the digital future of Bangladesh looks promising. This digital revolution is not only a path toward economic prosperity but a bridge that brings together urban and rural communities, connecting them to the global economy.

To improve the ease and smoothness of routine transactions, PriyoShop has teamed with Upay, UCB Fintech Company Limited's digital financial service brand, to rearrange them. This alliance aims to increase productivity, streamline processes, and empower blue-collar workers.

A New Era of Financial Efficiency

Imagine a world where collecting sales amounts from hubs is as easy as a few clicks and where blue-collar employees receive their salaries without any hassle. This is now a reality for PriyoShop’s overall network thanks to Upay’s cutting-edge digital financial services. উপায় (upay) was founded to become a companion that makes customer's journey simple, secure, and convenient while availing of financial services. উপায় (upay) products and services include mobile transactions, utility bill payment, in-store and e-commerce payment, inward remittance, salary disbursement, airtime recharge, and other value-added financial services. Customers can avail of the services from our nationwide agent and merchant network at an affordable charge.

  1. Seamless Sales Collection: Upay will enable PriyoShop to effortlessly collect sales amounts from hubs. This reduces the time and effort spent on manual cash handling, minimizes errors, and ensures accurate financial tracking.
  2. Efficient Salary Distribution: Blue-collar employees will now receive their salaries through Upay, providing them with a secure and efficient way to manage their finances. This ensures timely payments and reduces the risks associated with the traditional transactions.

Key officials now can track their sales, expenses, and profits in real-time, enabling better decision-making and financial planning.
  4. Increased Security: Digital transactions through Upay provide a higher level of security compared to cash-based operations. This reduces the risk of theft and fraud, offering peace of mind to both parties.

Empowering PriyoShop for Growth

This partnership is more than just a financial convenience; it’s a step towards empowering blue-collar employees by leveraging Upay’s digital solutions. :

  • Expand Our Market Reach: With efficient financial management, Priyoshop can focus on enhancing our business strategies.
  • Boost Profitability: Streamlined operations and reduced overhead costs lead to increased profitability, allowing PriyoShop to revamp its operations.
  • Improve Employee Satisfaction: Timely and secure salary payments through Upay enhance employee satisfaction and retention, contributing to a more stable workforce.
  • Simplify Business Operations: The ease of digital transactions simplifies day-to-day operations, freeing up time for PriyoShop to innovate and grow.

Conclusion

The partnership between PriyoShop and Upay marks a significant milestone in the digital transformation in Bangladesh. By getting access to seamless financial services, PriyoShop is not only simplifying supply chains but also empowering the entire compliance to achieve greater success.

item.title: The Future of B2B Marketplace: Embracing a Digital Revolution
item.dc:creator: Tosar
item.content:encoded:
The world is experiencing a rapid and seismic shift in the B2B business. Now, we can see that the traditional sales models that once relied heavily on face-to-face interactions and static processes are replaced by dynamic digital channels. As the years have passed, we are witnessing a universal transformation: every product or service is accessible through digital storefronts, self-service portals, or online purchasing options. This evolution demands a fundamental rethinking of how businesses attract and retain customers, bring products to market, function within supply chains and deliver services.

The Evolution of B2B Marketplace
The B2B marketplace has come a long way since the early days of clunky price lists on a basic website or if we go back to the traditional marketing strategies. Although, it seemed not every enterprise was convinced that it was necessary. Businesses around the world spent the past decade actively debating how important the B2B marketplace was, whether they should do it, or whether they even needed it. Right now there is no question whether businesses should be playing in the B2B marketplace space or have some form of digital self-service. Because COVID-10 didn’t just help us to adopt digital tools, it highlighted how much it is necessary. Businesses had to pivot rapidly to meet changing customer expectations and ensure operational continuity during the pandemic. Buyers increasingly favor online interactions over traditional methods, so B2B companies are rethinking their strategies to stay relevant.

As the reality has shifted from the pandemic, customers now expect their B2B suppliers to behave in a certain way and provide an experience and capabilities that resemble their consumer-facing buying experiences. Consumers have come to expect real-time visibility into stock availability, updates, and insights into their order status, one-click check-out, and expedited and next-day delivery options.

Current Situation of B2B Business in Bangladesh:

Bangladesh, with its robust SME sector and expanding industrial base, is witnessing a significant transformation in the realm of B2B marketplaces. The traditional methods of conducting business—often reliant on in-person negotiations, manual processes, and fragmented supply chains—are being reshaped by the integration of digital technologies. The shift toward digitalization has opened up new opportunities for businesses, creating a competitive landscape where adaptability and innovation are key.

Customer Expectations in the New Normal

As in global markets, consumers like MSMEs have begun to expect B2B companies to emulate B2C-like experiences. This includes:

  • Transparency: Real-time inventory updates and order tracking.
  • Ease of Use: Simplified platforms with user-friendly interfaces for seamless navigation.
  • Speed: Quick turnaround times, with many customers expecting next-day or even same-day delivery.
  • Digital Payment Options: Integration of mobile financial services like bKash, Nagad, and other payment gateways to facilitate transactions.

Challenges to Digital B2B Growth

Despite the progress, several challenges persist in Bangladesh’s B2B ecosystem:

  1. Digital Literacy: Many small business owners and suppliers are still unfamiliar with digital tools and platforms, limiting widespread adoption.
  2. Infrastructure: Inconsistent internet connectivity in rural and semi-urban areas hampers access to online platforms.
  3. Trust Issues: Traditional business relationships often rely on face-to-face trust-building, which is harder to replicate in a digital space.
  4. Logistics Limitations: Delivery networks, particularly in remote areas, are still developing and can delay supply chain efficiency. 

PriyoShop’s Steps Towards Adapting the B2B Business Model

Being a prominent B2B company, PriyoShop is revolutionizing the B2B prospects in Bangladesh by addressing the specific needs of MSMEs. We started to simplify procurement, distribution and operations, making it easier for businesses to connect with reliable suppliers and manufacturers.

By digitizing supply chains, we offer a user-friendly experience with multiple features in our app. Recognizing the financial challenges faced by MSMEs, PriyoShop has partnered with financial institutions to provide flexible credit solutions and secure payment options.

PriyoShop's commitment to inclusivity extends to rural areas, where it leverages its logistics network to reach even the most remote businesses. Additionally, our platform uses data-driven insights to help MSMEs make informed decisions and optimize their operations.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, PriyoShop played a crucial role in ensuring reliable supply chains and educating MSMEs on digital tools.

Conclusion 

The future of B2B marketplace in Bangladesh lies in its ability to embrace digital transformation fully. Companies like PriyoShop are paving the way by addressing the specific needs of MSMEs, creating inclusive platforms, and ensuring operational efficiency. As digital technologies continue to shape the global marketplace, businesses in Bangladesh have a unique opportunity to not only adapt but to lead in innovation and growth. By overcoming current challenges and fostering collaboration, the nation’s B2B ecosystem is poised to become a regional powerhouse in commerce, driving economic resilience and prosperity.
